independent: Every round is independent. Earlier patterns or results do not predict later ones, and the same rules apply to all players.

virtual-slots.intro: Three reels spin and stop on symbols chosen by the server using fixed weights (see the table).
virtual-slots.p1: Three matching symbols pay the largest multiplier in the table.
virtual-slots.p2: Exactly two matching symbols pay a small multiplier (two cherries pay 2x; a Bell pair and above returns the stake 1x).
virtual-slots.p4: Multipliers are total returns including the stake, in whole numbers.

euro-roulette.intro: The European wheel has 37 pockets (0-36). The server picks one pocket with uniform randomness.
euro-roulette.p1: You may place several bets at once; each bet is settled on its own.
euro-roulette.p2: A single number pays 36x (stake included), colour/odd-even/low-high 2x, dozens 3x.
euro-roulette.p3: Pocket 0 (green) beats every bet except a bet on number 0 or green.
euro-roulette.p4: Odds are computed exactly: average return of 97.3% (36/37) per bet type.

blackjack-21.intro: Get your card total as close to 21 as possible without going over, and beat the dealer's hand.
blackjack-21.p1: Hit, Stand, or Double down on your first two cards: an equal extra stake and exactly one more card.
blackjack-21.p2: The dealer stands on all 17s. A natural blackjack (Ace + ten-value card) pays 3:2; a normal win 1:1; a push returns your stake.
blackjack-21.p3: No split, insurance or surrender in this version.
blackjack-21.p4: The server holds every card and validates each move. The dealer's hidden card is never sent to the browser.

dice-duel.intro: The server rolls one 100-sided die (1-100). You guess whether it lands under or over your target number.
dice-duel.p1: Choose Under or Over, then slide the target. Your chance of hitting is shown immediately.
dice-duel.p2: The smaller the chance, the larger the return — using the open formula below.
dice-duel.p3: Returns are rounded down to whole coins.
